name: RDV-1 Occupancy Ray Query
definition: An occupancy-only ray query against a toroidal brick buffer that traces rays through a voxel grid to find the first occupied voxel, returning hit voxel coordinates, surface normal, distance, and step counts.
summary: The RDV-1 Occupancy Ray Query traces rays through a toroidal brick buffer to find the first occupied voxel, differing from related methods by operating across the entire grid and supporting arbitrary ray origins.
